description:

title: Towards Synergistic Teacher-AI Interactions with Generative Artificial Intelligence
description:
arXiv:2511.19580v2 Announce Type: replace-cross 
Abstract: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used in education, posing significant challenges for teachers adapting to these changes. GenAI offers unprecedented opportunities for accessibility, scalability and productivity in educational tasks. However, the automation of teaching tasks through GenAI raises concerns about reduced teacher agency, potential cognitive atrophy, and the broader deprofessionalisation of teaching.
